verdict: Basics are in place; structure and titles leave traffic on the table.

findings.title: Title tags are duplicated
findings.issue: Four pages share the title "Ananas Agency".
findings.impact_text: Search results look identical, which lowers clicks. It echoes the vague wording in [[hero]].
findings.fix: Write a unique title under 60 characters for each page, starting with the topic.

findings.title: Heading levels skip
findings.impact_text: Skipped levels confuse screen readers and search engines.
findings.fix: Use the levels in order and style them in CSS instead.

findings.title: No structured data
findings.issue: The site has no Organization or Service markup.
findings.impact_text: Search engines get less context about the business.
findings.fix: Add Organization markup first, then Service markup per offer.

strengths: A sitemap is published and listed in robots.txt
